content: Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Kọ án-are ọttọhk fa ńsi Phero, okhuri bi, ófona k'ẹfa chaam, kẹ ótte anọng paam ọbọhk, bẹ afona. Ófona k'ẹfa chaam, kẹ ọkhaam ma for sẹ ókhubh bẹ, k'ẹkhọma chẹ.”
Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Wa kaam nyini Abraham, ọmaana Isaak, ttara Jekọb abẹ, mach'Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir. Yina, kaam che chaam ch'ede Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kinjaakhi nnang bẹ.
Wa kaam mbiri nchekhi bi, nnang bẹ irerek sa Kenaan, nnuma s'iwa bẹ arukhi mach'akhekhennọng.
Kaam nkk'ẹmọng ch'anọng p'Israẹl abhomi k'ebira cha bẹ awobh k'Ijip mmaanga, kaam nkk'echekhi chaam mbiri njima.

“Mẹ wọ, gbaak anọng p'Israẹl bi, ‘Kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Kaam wọ ńnọbha bọng k'ọyak kw'ihem s'anọng p'Ijip. Kaam ḿbiri nnọbha bọng k'ebira cha bẹ akhe bọng. Kaam ndima ẹfa chaam mmek bọng, ḿbiri ndima chẹ ńsi aponga adaam bọng.
Kaam ńdọkha bọng mach'anọng paam, ḿbiri nde Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng. Órenga mẹ, bọng áronga bi, kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, kw'ọrọbh bọng k'ọyak kw'ihem s'anọng p'Ijip.

Kaam ḿbiri ndima bọng ma mpyiri k'irerek nnuma, s'iwa nchekhi ttara ọmmakkakkari bi, nnang Abraham, ọmaana Isaak, ttara Jekọb. Kaam ńnang bọng irerek nnuma bi, in-ide sabọng. Kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.’ ”
Wa Mosẹs ọtzọkha idik nna ọgbaak anọng p'Israẹl, yina, bẹ kẹ itzọhng kayong, okhuri akpen p'akk'bẹ abenga ọmaana ihem barambar sa bẹ awobh.
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi,
“Rọhng atza agbaak Phero kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Ijip bi, tte otte anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk bẹ abina aji ẹkhọma chẹ.”
Yina, Mosẹs ọbọbh Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, “Idikha anọng p'Israẹl an-itzọhng ayong anang-m, Phero on-osi yan oyong-m itzọhng o, da kaam nyekhi atzim o?”
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaak Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn odik kw'okhuri anọng p'Israẹl ọmaana ọvaar Phero kw'Ijip, ọnang ẹfa bi, bẹ atzima anọng p'Israẹl abina aji Ijip.
Efonamma cha Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn
Ma wọ ode aho pa mfona sabẹ: Va p'ijinọng pa Reubẹn, kw'ode ocheden-nwa kw'ijinọng kwa Israẹl ade: Hanọk, ọmaana Palu, ọmaana Hẹzrọn, ttara Karmi. Ma wọ iwa ode efona cha Reubẹn.
Wa Simeọn obhoni va p'ijinọng pa ade: Jemuyẹl, ọmaana Jamin, ọmaana Ọhad, ọmaana Jakin, ọmaana Zoha, ttara Shaul, kw'ode nnwa kw'oKenaan-kwanọng ọmaani ọnang-ẹ, Ma wọ iwa ode efona cha Simeọn.
Ma wọ ode che pa va p'ijinọng pa Lẹvi obhoni atzor ka ndori sabẹ; Gẹrshọn, ọmaana Kohat ttara Mẹrari. Biphyir-phyir wa Lẹvi orukhi cho arọbh azadani obhiri chi obhiri afa.
Wa va p'ijinọng pa Gẹrshọn obhoni ka nnọmma sabẹ ade: Libni ttara Shimeyi.
Wa va p'ijinọng pa Kohat obhoni ade: Amram, ọmaana Izha, ọmaana Hẹbrọn, ttara Uziyẹl. Biphyir-phyir wa Kohat orukhi cho arọbh azadani obhiri jobh obhiri attaan.
Wa Mẹrari obhon va p'ijinọng p'ade: Mali ọmaana Mushi. Ma wọ ode nnọmma sa Lẹvi atzor ka ndori sabẹ.
Wa Amram ọtzọk Jokẹbẹd kw'ode ọgbaanọkka kw'otte kwẹ, k'ọbada, kw'ọmaan-ẹ Aarọn ọmaana Mosẹs. Biphyir-phyir wa Amram orukhi cho arọbh azadani obhiri chi obhiri afa.
Wa Izha obhon va p'ijinọng p'ade: Kọra ọmaana Nẹphẹg, ttara Zikiri.
Wa Uziyẹl obhon va p'ijinọng p'ade: Mishayẹl, ọmaana Ẹlzaphan, ttara Sitri.
Wa Aarọn ọtzọk Ẹlisheba kw'ode ominanwa kw'Aminadab k'ọbada, kw'obiro ode ọgbaanọkka kwa Nashọn, ọmaan-ẹ Nadab ọmaana Abihu, ọmaana Ẹleyaza, ttara Itamar.
Va p'ijinọng pa Kọra ade Asir, ọmaana Ẹlkana, ttara Abiyasaph. Ma wọ iwa ode nnọmma sa Kọra.
Wa Ẹleyaza kw'Aarọn obhoni ọtzọk ominanwa kwa Putiyẹl k'ọbada, ọmaan-ẹ Phinẹhas.
Ma wọ iwa ode aho pa nhọhmmọr sa Lẹvi, k'ẹnọmma-k'ẹnọmma.
Aarọn nwa ttara Mosẹs bọ p'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obeni bi, “Bọng dima anọng p'Israẹl abina aji Ijip, ka ngaan sabẹ.”
Bẹ anọng mba afa kw'ode Aarọn ọmaana Mosẹs bọ iwa agbaakhi ọvaar Phero kw'Ijip atzim, okhuri ebina ch'anọng p'Israẹl k'Ijip.
Aarọn ọgbaakhi atzim k'eho cha Mosẹs
Mada Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọgbaakhi Mosẹs atzim k'Ijip,
oben Mosẹs bi, “Kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Gbaak ọvaar Phero kw'Ijip idik nna biphyir sa mgbaakh-ọ.”
Yina, Mosẹs oben Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, “Mada kaam nde ọnọng kw'oyekhi atzim, Phero on-osi yan oyong-m itzọhng o?”
